enterprise.name: Poultry Enterprise
enterprise.description: DRAFT - a poultry enterprise: manure emissions from the flock, plus the farm's energy, waste and upstream (Scope 3) emissions. No enteric fermentation module - poultry has none in the VEERG Module Map. Not yet ready for build-enterprise - the templateWorkbook does not exist yet and must be hand-authored (see enterprise-template-authoring.md).

customSheets.description: The Product EI results tab, unique to this enterprise. Module Results tabs are NOT imported; this sheet reads each module's result cells directly by named range.

customSheets.name: Input - Enterprise
customSheets.description: Optional enterprise-level input sheet for values shared across modules. Imported module input sheets are kept as-is alongside this one.

modules.comment: Sole owner of 'Input - Poultry' - unlike Swine/Dairy/BeefPasture/Feedlot, there is no Enteric_Poultry module (poultry has no Enteric Fermentation row in the VEERG Chapter 2 Module Map table), so no IMPORT-ORDER duplicate-input-sheet concern here. KNOWN BUILD BLOCKER: this module's groups include 'Livestock', which pulls in a sheet named 'Constants - Common Livestock' via the registry's sheetGroups.Livestock - but 4_6_ManureManagement_Poultry_WIP_v03.xlsx currently names that sheet 'Constants - Livestock' (confirmed 2026-08), the same mismatch Swine hit. Rename that sheet to 'Constants - Common Livestock' in the source workbook (matching what was done for Swine) BEFORE running build-enterprise, or the build will fail with "'Constants - Common Livestock' (category constants) not found".
Fertiliser constants required for manure sent off site calcs (same dependency as Enterprise_Swine.json).

Per the Chapter 2 doc's Poultry MODULE MAP TABLE (authoritative - not the prose 'additional guidance' sentence): relevant Scope 3 rows are 15.1 Purchased Livestock, 15.2 Purchased Feed, 15.7 Purchased Services/Contractors, 15.10 Other Purchased Goods and Services, 15.11 Upstream Emission from Fuel, 15.12 Upstream Emissions of Purchased Electricity, 15.13 Management of Waste - identical set to Swine's table. The '15 Scope 3' calc sheet carries all Scope3 sub-sections with no per-row subsetting available, so irrelevant rows (15.3 mineral supplements, 15.4 fertiliser components, 15.5 agrichemicals, 15.6 lime, 15.8 packaging, 15.9 grow media, 15.14 freight - NOT in the poultry table) will still show up when listing/pasting results; pick only the relevant rows by hand. OPEN QUESTION (same as Swine): 'Input - Freight' is kept below since freight-adjacent quantities may still feed other included rows, but the table does not list a distinct Freight module (15.14) for poultry the way it does for Dairy/PastureBeef - worth confirming whether it's actually needed before building.

menu.comment: The column-A navigation menu is regenerated on every sheet from the final sheet set. Groups are assigned automatically: Home/Results = untitled; any sheet named 'Input*' = INPUTS; calculation sheets = CALCULATIONS; everything else = APPENDICES. 'labels' overrides the link text for a sheet (default derivation strips the 'Input - ' prefix, otherwise uses the sheet name). Set enabled=false to leave existing menus untouched.
